commands_run: cargo test --locked --no-fail-fast -p xtask -p athena-core -p athena-cli --test policy --test mirrors --test site_page

policy_denials.detail: cd <job>/work; wc -l xtask/src/site.rs xtask/src/decisions.rs; grep -n "fn \|CSS\|</header>" xtask/src/site.rs | head -120; grep -n -B2 -A12 "OLY-B-D2-02" docs/spec.toml
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p xtask 2>&1 | tail -30
